name: budget
description: Personal finance: accounts, categorized and recurring transactions, monthly budgets with rollover and spending summaries.
author: test2 author (independent of the reviewer)

issues.description: The docstring promises an average per calendar month, counting months without spending, but the total is divided by the number of transactions.
issues.fix_hint: Divide by the number of months from first's month to last's month.

issues.description: A rule due on the 29th to 31st should fall on the last day of shorter months, but the date is built directly and raises ValueError for February or 30-day months.
issues.fix_hint: Clamp day_of_month to the number of days in the month (calendar.monthrange).

issues.description: Rollover should carry the unspent part (available - spent) into the next month; the subtraction is reversed, so overspending is carried and savings are dropped.
issues.fix_hint: carry = max(available - spent, ZERO) when rollover is on.

issues.description: The search text is formatted into the SQL string, so quotes in it change the query (and a memo with an apostrophe breaks the search).
issues.fix_hint: Pass the pattern as a ? parameter.

issues.description: The storage layer imports the presentation module (and through it summaries and budgets) just to format an amount; money formatting belongs in budget.money.
render_month re-implements the per-category spending totals that summary.spending_by_category already computes.
_right is never called; the report formats widths inline.

decoys.anchor: where = f" WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
decoys.why_it_is_fine: The f-string only joins fixed clause strings written in the code; every user value is passed as a ? parameter.
The broad except logs which recurring rule failed and re-raises, so no error is swallowed.
